Exciting AI Updates Weekly - April 24, 2026 - Part 1
Presented by Lev Selector

--------- Contents of today's video:

00:00 Introduction
00:42 Crowd-sourced "LM Arena" Leaderboard
00:58 GPT-5.5 Released
01:25 DeepSeek V4 Preview
02:30 Cursor AI - Agent-first coding
04:25 SaaS with AI on Client Side
06:11 4-Steps Development
07:54 Matt Berman on Vibe Coding
08:26 Matt Berman on Opus 4.7
09:05 JourneyChat Agent-to-Agent
09:23 Anthropic Claude Design
10:02 OpenAI ChatGPT Images 2.0
10:25 State of the Claw - Peter Steinberger
11:36 Apple CEO Change
12:01 New world models
12:25 AI Agent Traps - DeepMind Cybersecurity
13:14 Kimi K2.6
13:43 Alibaba Qwen 3.6-Max-Preview

----

Takeaways:

1. Development is shifting from writing code to orchestrating AI agents through a four-step workflow: architecture, design, plan, implementation. You do no work yourself, you steer.

2. Every user will soon have a personal AI agent, much like a browser. Agents use skills, MCP, and memory to drive applications on the user's behalf.

3. AI agents face new security risks. Websites can detect agents and serve hidden HTML instructions, commands encoded in image pixels, or jailbreaks inside PDFs. Defenses are weak.

----

Quotes:

"A week in AI is a year in any other field. The best model is whichever one shipped this morning."

"We stopped writing code. We started describing it. The IDE is dead. Long live the task list."

"One prompt, thousand tool calls, 4,000 lines, and a coffee break."

----

Summary:

In this talk I cover the AI updates for April 24. 

Claude still leads the leaderboard. 
GPT-5.5 shipped with mixed reviews. DeepSeek V4 arrived at 1.6 trillion parameters with a 1M token context. 
Cursor 3 replaced the code editor with an agents window. 
I explain the new SaaS model with client-side agents and the four-step agent development workflow. 
Matt Berman covered the dark side of vibe coding and Opus 4.7. 
JourneyChat enables agent-to-agent communication. 
Claude Design hit Figma and Adobe stocks. 
ChatGPT Images 2.0 jumped 242 ELO. 
Peter Steinberger described OpenClaw and a dreaming feature for agent memory. 
Tim Cook is stepping down, John Ternus becomes Apple CEO September 1. 
World models are expanding.
